bullets.text: AI Takes Centre Stage - Super Bowl LX ads will prominently feature AI, including a jab at **OpenAI** by **Anthropic**.
Tech Showcase at Super Bowl - Levi's Stadium is a hub for advanced tech, enhancing the viewing experience for fans.
TV Spending Surge - US adults plan to spend an average of $1,177 on new TVs for the Super Bowl.
NFL Sunday Ticket Available Early - **YouTube TV** offers NFL Sunday Ticket for the 2026 season ahead of the Super Bowl.
Spotify Expands Offerings - **Spotify** will allow premium users in the UK to buy physical books through its app.
Fundamental's Big Data Breakthrough - **Fundamental** raises $255M to enhance big data analysis with a new AI model.
Reddit's AI Search Ambitions - **Reddit** is exploring AI-powered search as a significant growth opportunity.
OpenAI's New AI Agent Tools - **OpenAI** launches Frontier, a platform for enterprises to build and manage AI agents.
Elon Musk's Orbital Data Centers - **SpaceX** plans a million-satellite data center network to enhance AI computing.
NASA Astronauts Get Smartphones - For the first time, NASA astronauts can bring smartphones on missions to the moon.
